kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-mcp-server --name my-mcp-server --config - --visibility TENANT --visibility-scope '{"ProjectIds":["123456"],"UserIds":["123456"]}' --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateMcpServer

parameters.help_en: The name of the MCP Server. The name must be unique at the tenant level. It must start with a lowercase letter and contain only characters from `a-z`, `0-9`, `_`, and `-`
parameters.help_zh: MCP Server 名称，租户级唯一；以小写字母开头，仅允许 `a-z` / `0-9` / `_` / `-`
parameters.name: name

fields.help_en: The service address of the MCP Server. It must start with `https://`
fields.help_zh: MCP Server 服务地址，必须以 `https://` 开头
fields.name: url

fields.help_en: The custom request headers, specified as key-value pairs. You cannot override reserved headers
fields.help_zh: 自定义请求头（键值对）；保留头不允许覆盖
fields.name: custom_headers

parameters.help_en: The connection configuration for the MCP Server
parameters.name: config

fields.help_en: The project IDs to which the MCP Server is visible. This parameter is required only when `Visibility` is set to `PROJECT`
fields.help_zh: 可见的项目 ID 列表，Visibility 为 `PROJECT` 时生效
fields.name: project_ids

fields.help_en: The user IDs to which the MCP Server is visible. This parameter is required only when `Visibility` is set to `USER`
fields.help_zh: 可见的用户 ID 列表，Visibility 为 `USER` 时生效
fields.name: user_ids

parameters.help_en: The visibility scope. The required fields depend on the value of the `Visibility` parameter
parameters.help_zh: 可见性范围，按 Visibility 取对应字段
parameters.name: visibility_scope
